success.chequeBounced: The cheque was marked bounced. The charges it paid are open again.
success.creditApplied: The credit was applied to open charges

error.flatInactive: This flat is inactive and cannot be charged
error.replacesNotVoid: Only a voided entry can be replaced. Void the original first.
error.alreadyReplaced: This voided entry already has a correction
error.voidRunInstead: This charge belongs to a billing run. Ask an admin to void the whole run.
error.invalidCursor: The list changed. Reload it from the start.
error.periodOutOfRange: Charges can be booked from the finance go-live month up to 12 months ahead
error.hasAllocations: This charge has payments allocated to it. Void the payment first or move it to credit.
error.voidNotAllowed: You can void only your own entries on the day you posted them. Ask an admin.
error.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 5 characters
error.periodClosed: This accounting period is closed. Post a correction in an open period.
error.invalidPeriod: The period must be written YYYY-MM
error.invalidPeriodRange: Choose a range of 1 to 60 months, the start before the end
error.invalidAmount: Enter the amount as a number
error.amountPrecision: Amounts can have at most 2 decimal places
error.amountOutOfRange: The amount must be between 0.01 and 9,999,999.99
error.idempotencyKeyRequired: The Idempotency-Key header is required (8 to 100 letters, digits, - or _)
error.idempotencyConflict: This request key was already used for a different request
error.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future
error.receivedOutOfRange: Payments can be dated from the finance go-live month up to today. Older money belongs to the opening balances.
error.allocationExceedsPayment: The allocations add up to more than the payment
error.allocationExceedsCharge: An allocation is larger than what is still open on that charge
error.allocationChargeNotOpen: One of the charges is not an open charge of this flat
error.duplicateAllocation: Each charge can appear only once
error.duplicateReference: A payment with this method and reference is already recorded. Check it, then post again with force to record it anyway.
error.voidImportInstead: This is an opening-balance row. Ask an admin to void the import batch.
error.notACheque: This payment is not a cheque
error.alreadyFinal: This cheque is already cleared or bounced
error.dateBeforeReceived: The date cannot be before the payment was received
error.insufficientCredit: The flat does not have enough credit for this
error.nothingToAllocate: There is no open charge to apply the credit to
error.creditSourceConflict: The credit left is from a payment that already part-paid this charge. Pick another charge or record a new payment.
error.attachmentType: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WEBP photo, or a PDF
error.attachmentTooLarge: Photos can be up to 5 MB and PDFs up to 10 MB
error.attachmentInvalid: Attach a file you uploaded through the finance desk
error.attachmentExpired: This upload is too old to attach. Upload the file again.
error.attachmentInUse: This file is already attached to another payment
